status: draft, not applied to runtime or accepted by the playtester
provenance: Original paths authored for this package; no imported icon library or raster assets. Art cues derived from src/scene/models.ts in GitHub8052cfc.
usage: Inline SVG within a native labeled button, decorative aria-hidden=true. Set currentColor on button; optionally set --cove-icon-accent. For disabled/monochrome, set --cove-icon-accent:currentColor. Do not use CSS rotation to swap the Board/Unload semantics. SVGs carry no text; accessible names belong to the button. External img rendering does not inherit currentColor.

icons.label: Board
icons.meaning: Arrow descends toward the open ferry deck. Keep the visible Board label for consequential transfer actions.

icons.label: Unload
icons.meaning: Arrow rises away from the same ferry deck. This means unload selected animals, never discard or delete.

icons.label: Sail
icons.meaning: Compact ferry with trailing travel marks. Labels retain destination and action consequences.

icons.label: Harbor · Home
icons.meaning: The cove lighthouse identifies the rescue destination. It must not be used for Back to boat, a main menu or a free travel action.

icons.label: Undo
icons.meaning: Return to the previous complete action. Kept distinct from Restart.

icons.label: Wait
icons.meaning: An hourglass marks an explicit turn-spending wait. The icon is not a countdown of real time.

icons.label: Whole cove
icons.meaning: Three islands and curved passages identify the entire cove framing.

icons.label: Back to boat
icons.meaning: Framing corners around the ferry recenter the camera only; this must not resemble Harbor Home.

icons.label: Menu
icons.meaning: Two softly rounded slats for the Crossing menu.

icons.label: Settings
icons.meaning: Two adjustable pins provide a familiar settings metaphor without ornate machinery.

icons.label: Close
icons.meaning: Dismiss the current surface without committing an action.

icons.label: Confirm
icons.meaning: Commit the currently previewed selection; keep explicit visible action text and consequences.

icons.label: Next cove
icons.meaning: A curved onward path from an island identifies progression after arrival.

icons.label: Mute sound
icons.meaning: Audio is currently playing; the action label is Mute sound.

icons.label: Enable sound
icons.meaning: Audio is muted; the action label is Enable sound.

icons.label: Retry sound
icons.meaning: Sound was requested but is not running. The visible Retry label must remain; this is not mute.

icons.label: Fullscreen
icons.meaning: Expand the common app root using the existing trusted fullscreen path.

icons.label: Exit fullscreen
icons.meaning: Leave actual fullscreen. Never infer state from an optimistic toggle.
